Goldman Capital Management Inc decreased its stake in Cyren Ltd (Cyrn) (CYRN) by 36.1% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Goldman Capital Management Inc sold 931,264 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.12% with the market. The institutional investor held 1.65M shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.12M, down from 2.58M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Goldman Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Cyren Ltd (Cyrn) for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $149.52 million market cap company. The stock decreased 1.75% or $0.05 $2.8. About 4,099 shares traded. CYREN Ltd. (NASDAQ:CYRN) has risen 17.95% uptrending. It has outperformed by 6.40% the S&P500.
One Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 9.67% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC.
